r_b5_10.strat: SAT TEXT STRUCTURE: Uch bosqichli xronologiyani ajrating: Past (For decades) -> Turning point (In 2002) -> Present (Today).

r_b5_11.exp: Matn Jenkinsning tajribaviy tadqiqoti (izotopik uglerod tekshiruvi) ilgari skeptiklar tomonidan inkor etilgan 'o'simliklararo resurs almashinuvi' gipotezasini qat'iy isbotlab berganini yoritish uchun yozilgan. A varianti ushbu asosiy maqsadni eng to'liq va aniq ifodalaydi. C varianti metodni rad etishni aytib matnga zid, B esa daraxtlar ko'chatlarga yordam berayotganiga teskari.
r_b5_11.strat: SAT PURPOSE HACK: Skeptiklarning dastlabki shubhasini yenguvchi ilmiy dalilni taqdim etish matnning markaziy niyatidir.

r_b5_12.exp: Birinchi gapda tog' jinslarining 3 ta turi (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic) aytiladi. Ikkinchi gap esa ulardan birinchisi - magma/lavaning sovishidan hosil bo'ladigan vulqon (igneous) jinslarining xususiyatini ta'riflab beradi. Shuning uchun D varianti eng to'g'ri tahlildir.
r_b5_12.strat: SAT SENTENCE FUNCTION: 1-gap umumiy toifalarni sanaydi, 2-gap esa 1-toifaga (igneous) bevosita aniqlik kiritadi.

r_b5_13.exp: Muallif Yelizaveta davri saroy she'riyatini ('ornate, decorative phrasing') Donnening yangicha, suhbatdoshlikka asoslangan uslubini solishtirish va uning o'ziga xosligini bo'rtirib ko'rsatish uchun an'anaviy fon (stylistic baseline) sifatida keltirmoqda. A, C va D matnda aytilmagan asossiz xulosalardir.
r_b5_13.strat: SAT RHETORICAL FUNCTION: An'anaviy uslubni keltirishdan maqsad - yangi muallifning innovatsiyasini kontrast orqali yaqqol ko'rsatishdir.

r_b5_14.exp: Kuan (Text 1) nobiologik (abiotic) sintez imkonsiz deb hisoblaydi va shuning uchun fosfin mikrobial hayot dalili deydi. Rostova (Text 2) esa buni inkor etib, o'z laboratoriya modellarida vulqon minerallari (abiotic) orqali hech qanday biologiyasiz fosfin hosil bo'lishini ko'rsatgan. Shuning uchun Rostova Kuan nobiologik vulqon mexanizmlarini hisobga olmagan deb e'tiroz bildiradi. B to'g'ri.
r_b5_14.strat: SAT PAIRED TEXTS: Kuan: 'abiotic synthesis is unfeasible' <-> Rostova: 'laboratory models show abiotic volcanic plumes produce it'. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri B varianti.

r_b5_15.exp: Bennett tashqi bosqinlarni asosiy sabab deb biladi. Al-Mansoor esa tashqi bosqinlar faqatgina 'so'nggi zarba' (final blow) bo'lganini, imperiyaning haqiqiy va chuqur sababi ichki iqtisodiy inqiroz va xazinaning bo'shab qolishi ekanini ta'kidlaydi. Demak, u Bennettning qarashini asosiy sababni yuzaki turtki (catalytic event) bilan adashtirish deb baholaydi. C to'g'ri.
r_b5_15.strat: SAT PAIRED TEXT STRATEGY: 'merely administered the final blow to an empire already hollowed out' iborasi C variantidagi 'mistaking immediate catalytic event for underlying systemic causes' bilan to'liq ma'nodosh.

r_b5_16.exp: Text 1 shartsiz pul o'tkazmalari (UBI) xodimlarga erkinlik beradi va yaxshiroq ish topishga yordam beradi deb ijobiy baholaydi. Text 2 esa bu ishchi kuchi taklifining kamayishiga (ish soatlarini qisqartirishga) olib keladi deb xavotir bildiradi. Demak, ularning asosiy kelishmovchiligi shartsiz to'lovlarning mehnat bozoridagi ishtirokiga (workforce participation) ta'siri ustidadir. B to'g'ri.
r_b5_16.strat: SAT COMPARISON: Text 1 (UBI fosters career advancement) vs Text 2 (UBI risks labor force withdrawal). Munozara markazi: mehnat ishtiroki.

r_b5_17.exp: Chomsky (Text 1) tug'ma, faqat tilga xos 'universal grammar' (innate neural circuitry) mavjudligini aytadi. Tomasello (Text 2) esa maxsus til moduli o'rniga bolalar umumiy aqliy qobiliyatlar (general cognitive mechanisms: pattern-finding, intention-reading) va atrof-muhit bilan muloqot orqali tilni o'rganishini isbotlaydi. Shuning uchun A varianti ularning tub farqini to'liq ko'rsatadi.
r_b5_17.strat: SAT CORE CONTRAST: Chomsky (innate domain-specific grammar) vs Tomasello (general pattern-finding cognition from input).

r_b5_18.exp: Matnning so'nggi qismida aniq ta'kidlangan: 'the duration of the waggle run indicates the distance to the floral food source'. Demak, masofani tebranish yugurishining davomiyligi (duration) bildiradi. C varianti quyoshga nisbatan yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.
r_b5_18.strat: SAT DETAIL DIRECT MATCH: 'duration ... indicates the distance'. Matndagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri dalil bilan solishtiring.

r_b5_19.exp: Matn gaz yoritgichlari paydo bo'lishi bilan shaharlarda kechki payt xavfsizlik va erkin harakat ta'minlangani, savdo soatlari uzayib, tungi iqtisodiyot va ko'ngilochar maskanlar rivojlangani haqida. D varianti barcha keltirilgan faktlarni o'z ichiga olgan bosh g'oyadir.
r_b5_19.strat: SAT MAIN IDEA HACK: 1-gapdagi 'fundamentally reshaped urban social geography' va oxirgi gapdagi 'stimulated nocturnal commercial economy' umumlashtirilib A hosil bo'ladi.

r_b5_20.exp: Matnda boyqush patlarining tuzilishi havo turbulentligini kichik girdoblarga bo'lib yuborishi, tovush tebranishlarini yutishi va shu orqali parvoz paytida shovqin chiqarmaslikka ('suppress flight noise / virtually silent flight') xizmat qilishi aytilgan. A varianti matnga to'liq mos keladi.
r_b5_20.strat: SAT PARAPHRASE: 'break up sound-producing turbulence ... achieving silent flight' = 'dissipate air turbulence to suppress audible noise'.

r_b5_21.exp: Matn Mohenjo-daro shahrida saroylar va dabdabali qabrlarning yo'qligi hamda buning o'rniga barcha aholi uchun standart uylar, suv quvurlari va kanalizatsiya tizimiga ustuvorlik berilgani shahar yakka hokimlik emas, balki teng huquqli (egalitarian civic model) boshqaruvga tayanganini ko'rsatishini ta'kidlaydi. A to'g'ri.
r_b5_21.strat: SAT CENTRAL CLAIM: 'suggesting an egalitarian civic governance structure rather than autocratic royal rule' matnning xulosa g'oyasidir.

r_b5_22.exp: Matn so'ngida aniq aytilgan: xlorofill ko'k va qizil nurlarni yutadi (absorb), yashil nurni esa qaytaradi (reflecting green wavelengths), shu sababli barglar yashil ko'rinadi. A varianti to'g'ridan-to'g'ri matnga asoslangan.
r_b5_22.strat: SAT DIRECT FACT CHECK: 'reflecting green wavelengths, which gives foliage its characteristic emerald hue' = B.

r_b5_23.exp: 1-gapda avvalgi adabiyotshunoslarning an'anaviy qarashi (ayol yozuvchilar yolg'iz va noma'lum bo'lgan degan faraz) keltiriladi. 2-gapda esa Rao tomonidan topilgan yangi arxiv hujjatlari (qo'lyozma to'garaklari va hamkorlik tarmoqlari) bu qarashni rad etgani bayon qilinadi. B varianti ushbu munosabatni aniq tasvirlaydi.
r_b5_23.strat: SAT SENTENCE RELATIONSHIP: 'While historians portrayed X ... recent archival discoveries challenge this narrative' = established assumption refuted by new evidence.

r_b5_24.exp: Gomezning gipotezasi: zahar qurbaqaning o'zida emas, uning yeydigan hasharotlaridan to'planadi (dietary sequestration). Agar laboratoriyada oddiy meva pashshasi bilan boqilgan qurbaqalar zahar chiqara olmasa, lekin Amazonka kanalari bilan oziqlanganda darhol zaharga ega bo'lsa, bu zaharning bevosita ozuqadan kelib chiqishini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri isbotlaydi. C varianti gipotezani to'liq qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
r_b5_24.strat: SAT EVIDENCE HACK: Gipotezani qo'llash: dietani o'zgartirish natijasida zahar paydo bo'lishi/yo'qolishi C variantida mukammal aks etgan.

r_b5_25.exp: Chenning nazariyasi: tabiatda yurish diqqatni tiklaydi (restores directed attention), shahardagi shovqin esa charchatadi. Agar o'rmonda 45 daqiqa sayr qilganlar gavjum shaharda yurganlarga qaraganda xatolarni sezilarli darajada kam qilsa (diqqat talab qiluvchi vazifada), bu tabiatning diqqatni tiklashini eksperimental tasdiqlaydi. D varianti to'g'ri.
r_b5_25.strat: SAT EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT: Nazariyada aytilgan ta'sir (tabiat = yaxshi diqqat; shahar = toliqish) bevosita D variantidagi natijada o'lchangan.

r_b5_26.exp: Olimlarning maqsadi: qurg'oqchilikda hosildorlikni saqlab qolish. Biroq stomatalarni yopish karbonat angidrid kirishini to'xtatadi. Agar o'simlik qurg'oqchilikda stomatalarini yopib, karbonat angidrid yetishmovchiligi (carbon starvation) sababli don hosili keskin tushib ketsa, bu olimlarning hosilni saqlash maqsadiga eng katta to'siq (substantial challenge) bo'ladi. C to'g'ri.
r_b5_26.strat: SAT WEAKEN/CHALLENGE EVIDENCE: Maqsad: hosildorlikni saqlash. Salbiy oqibat: karbonat yetishmasligi hosilni barbod qildi (C).

r_b5_27.exp: Vegenerning gipotezasi qit'alarni qaysi mexanizm harakatga keltirishini tushuntira olmagani uchun rad etilgan edi. 1960-yillarda okean o'rtasidagi tizmalarda paleomagnit qatlamlar va mantiya konveksiyasi orqali okean tubining kengayishi (seafloor spreading) kashf etilishi ushbu harakatlantiruvchi mexanizmni isbotlab berdi. Shuning uchun B to'g'ri.
r_b5_27.strat: SAT HISTORICAL EVIDENCE: 'failed to identify physical mechanism' muammosini 'seafloor spreading driven by mantle convection' kashfiyoti to'liq yechdi.

r_b5_28.exp: Matnda aytilgan hodisa: kam sonli so'zlashuvchiga ega tillarda nihoyatda murakkab morfologiya (ko'plab affikslar, bitta fe'lga butun gap ma'nosini joylash) bo'ladi. D variantidagi Inuit-Yupik tillari (polysynthetic verbs where a single word incorporates subject, object, etc.) aynan shu xususiyatni mukammal ko'rsatadi.
r_b5_28.strat: SAT EXEMPLIFICATION: 'intricate verb systems with dozens of affixes' misoli D variantidagi 'polysynthetic verbs' bilan 100% mos.

r_b5_29.exp: Matn boshida qushlarning sayrashi katta energiya talab qilishi va yirtqichlar xavfini oshirishi aytiladi. Shuning uchun murakkab va baland qo'shiq aytish qushning sog'lom va kuchli ekanini bildiradi ('honest signal of fitness'). Demak, faqat kuchi va resursi ko'p bo'lgan qushlargina bu xavf va energiya sarfiga bardosh bera oladi ('sustain prolonged vocal displays while coping with risks'). A to'g'ri.
r_b5_29.strat: SAT LOGICAL COMPLETION: 'honest signal of fitness: only males with abundant reserves can afford to [do the costly behavior]' -> A.

r_b5_30.exp: Matnda chang va zarrachalardan xoli toza suv -40 darajagacha muzlamasdan suyuq qolishi ko'rsatilgan, chunki muz kristali hosil bo'lishi uchun yadro (nucleation surface) kerak. Bundan xulosa kelib chiqadiki, oddiy tabiatda suvning 0 darajada muzlashi unda muzlash yadrosi bo'lib xizmat qiluvchi mikroskopik zarrachalar va kirlarning (particulate impurities) mavjudligiga bog'liq. A to'g'ri.
r_b5_30.strat: SAT LOGICAL INFERENCE: 'lack of foreign nucleation surfaces prevents ice' -> 'freezing at 0 D requires foreign particulate impurities'.

r_b5_31.exp: Matnda konsert e'lon qilinishi bilan algoritm inson aralashuvisiz bir lahzada narxlarni oshirishi aytilgan. Bu algoritmik narxlashning talab o'zgarishlariga inson aralashuvisiz bir zumda tezkor javob berishini ('responds rapidly to shifts in demand without requiring human intervention') ko'rsatadi. A to'g'ri.
r_b5_31.strat: SAT INFERENCE: 'instantaneously multiplies room rates upon concert announcement' -> 'responds rapidly to sudden shifts without human intervention'.

r_b5_32.exp: Matnda gematoensefalik to'siq (blood-brain barrier) miyani infeksiyalardan himoya qilishi bilan birga, tibbiyot uchun to'siq ekani ta'kidlanadi. Sababi to'siq molekulalarni miyaga o'tkazmaydi. Demak, 98% dan ortiq dori vositalari bu to'siqdan klinik ta'sir ko'rsatadigan konsentratsiyada o'ta olmaydi ('unable to cross the barrier in sufficient concentrations'). B to'g'ri.
r_b5_32.strat: SAT LOGICAL COMPLETION: 'formidable therapeutic obstacle' + 'restricts polar molecules' -> dori miyaga o'ta olmaydi (B).

r_b5_33.exp: Tishdagi izotoplar ichilgan suvdan o'tadi va ular yomg'irli hamda quruq mavsumlarda o'zgaradi. Demak, o'sha davrdagi mahalliy yog'ingarchilik va yer usti suv manbalari davriy mavsumiy tebranishlarga ega bo'lgan ('experienced consistent cyclical seasonal fluctuations'). A to'g'ri.
r_b5_33.strat: SAT INFERENCE: Izotoplar ichimlik suvidan olinadi + fasllar bo'yicha farq qiladi -> iqlim va suv manbalari mavsumiy o'zgargan.

w_b5_01.exp: Matnda ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses) mavjud: 1) 'The resulting plates confirmed Einstein's theory of relativity'; 2) 'they provided the first empirical measurement...'. Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash uchun vergul + FANBOYS koordinatsion bog'lovchisi (bu yerda 'for' = chunki, sababi) qo'llaniladi: ', for'. Vergulsiz bog'lash (B) xato, D dagi nuqtali vergul bilan 'for' qo'shilmaydi, A esa ortiqcha 'and' qo'shgan.
w_b5_01.strat: SAT GRAMMAR RULE: Vergul + FANBOYS (for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so) ikkita to'liq mustaqil gapni to'g'ri bog'laydi.

w_b5_02.exp: 'including' so'zidan keyin yoki oldin ikki nuqta (:) qo'yilmaydi, chunki 'including' o'zi misollarni kirituvchi predikativ so'z hisoblanadi. Vergul bilan 'instruments, including broadband seismometers...' deb davom etish grammatik jihatdan to'liq to'g'ri. C va A variantlari ikki nuqtani xato ishlatgan.
w_b5_02.strat: SAT PUNCTUATION RULE: 'Including', 'such as' kabi so'zlardan keyin hech qachon ikki nuqta (colon) qo'yilmaydi!

w_b5_03.exp: Bu yerda ikkita mustaqil gap bor: 1) 'Architect Zaha Hadid was celebrated for her dynamic, fluid designs'; 2) 'her avant-garde structures rejected conventional right angles...'. Hech qanday tinish belgisiz qoldirish (B) run-on sentence xatosidir; faqat vergul qo'yish (D) comma splice xatosidir; C varianti ikkinchi gapni to'liq bog'lay olmaydi. Nuqtali vergul (;) ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lashning eng ideal usulidir.
w_b5_03.strat: SAT COMMA SPLICE TRAP: Ikkita mustaqil gap o'rtasiga faqat vergul qo'yish (comma splice) qat'iyan taqiqlanadi! Semicolon (;) kerak.

w_b5_04.exp: Birinchi qism mustaqil to'liq gap ('...returned from vacation to discover a contaminated petri dish'). Ikki nuqtadan (:) keyingi qism esa u idishda aynan nima sodir bo'lganini tushuntirib, oydinlashtirib beradi ('a stray Penicillium mold had contaminated...'). Ikki nuqta oldingi mustaqil gapda aytilgan narsani izohlash yoki batafsil bayon qilish uchun to'g'ri ishlatiladi. C varianti comma splice hosil qiladi.
w_b5_04.strat: SAT COLON RULE: Mustaqil gapdan keyin kelgan ikki nuqta (:) oldingi fikrni batafsil izohlash, ta'riflash yoki ochib berish uchun xizmat qiladi.

w_b5_05.exp: Ikki nuqta (:) to'liq mustaqil gapdan keyin keladigan ro'yxatni kiritish uchun ishlatiladi: 'The committee evaluated three candidate historic sites:' (to'liq gap) -> 1) tegirmon, 2) sud binosi, 3) soat minorasi. Nuqtali vergul (B) ro'yxat kiritish uchun ishlatilmaydi; oddiy vergul (D) noaniqlik tug'diradi.
w_b5_05.strat: SAT LIST INTRODUCER: To'liq mustaqil gapdan keyin ro'yxat kiritishda ikki nuqta (:) qo'yiladi.

w_b5_06.exp: Gap 'Although' (bog'lovchi) bilan boshlanuvchi tobe ergash gap (dependent clause) bilan boshlanmoqda: 'Although deep-sea anglerfish live in complete oceanic darkness...'. Qoida bo'yicha, tobe gap bosh gapdan oldin kelganda, ularning o'rtasiga faqat vergul (,) qo'yiladi. Nuqtali vergul (D) yoki ikki nuqta (C) tobe gapdan keyin qo'yilmaydi.
w_b5_06.strat: SAT DEPENDENT CLAUSE: Dependent clause boshida kelsa: [Dependent Clause], [Independent Clause]. Faqat oddiy vergul kerak!

w_b5_07.exp: 'furthermore' - bu konjunktiv ravish (conjunctive adverb). U ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash uchun ishlatilganda, uning oldiga nuqtali vergul (;), orqasiga esa vergul (,) qo'yilishi shart: '; furthermore,'. Vergul bilan bog'lash (D) xato (comma splice), A va C esa tinish belgisiz bo'lgani uchun run-on hosil qiladi.
w_b5_07.strat: SAT CONJUNCTIVE ADVERB: However, furthermore, therefore, moreover kabi so'zlar ikkita gap orasida kelganda: [; furthermore, ] shaklida bo'ladi.

w_b5_08.exp: Gapda kiritma izoh (parenthetical phrase) uzun tire (em-dash) bilan ochilgan: 'Adichie—whose works explore...'. Qoida bo'yicha, tire bilan ochilgan kiritma ibora xuddi shunday mos keluvchi ikkinchi tire bilan yopilishi shart: 'cultural displacement—'. Vergul (B) yoki nuqtali vergul (A) juft tire balansini buzadi.
w_b5_08.strat: SAT DASH PAIRING: Agar kiritma tire (—) bilan boshlangan bo'lsa, u faqat ikkinchi tire (—) bilan yopilishi shart!

w_b5_09.exp: Ega-kesim moslashuvi (subject-verb agreement): Ega 'the synchronized firing' (otlashgan gerundiy - birlikda). Undan keyingi 'of neurons in the hippocampus' - oraliqdagi predlogli aniqlovchi ibora bo'lib, egaga ta'sir qilmaydi. Birlikdagi ega 'firing' uchun birlikdagi fe'l 'is' talab qilinadi. C, B, D variantlari ko'plikdagi fe'llardir.
w_b5_09.strat: SAT SUBJECT-VERB TRAP: Oraliqdagi 'of neurons in the hippocampus' iborasini chizib tashlang! Ega: 'the firing' (singular) -> 'is'.

w_b5_10.exp: 'Neither ... nor' bog'lovchisida fe'l o'ziga eng yaqin turgan ega bilan moslashadi (Proximity Rule). Fe'lga eng yaqin turgan ega - 'the principal laboratory director' (birlikda). Shuning uchun o'tgan zamondagi birlik shakli 'was' to'g'ri bo'ladi. C varianti uzoqdagi 'fellows' ko'pligi bilan adashtiruvchi tuzoqdir.
w_b5_10.strat: SAT PROXIMITY RULE: 'Neither A nor B' kelganda fe'l doimo nor dan keyingi C ga qarab moslashadi: director (singular) -> was.

w_b5_11.exp: Gapning to'liq kesimi (main finite verb) yetishmayapti. Boshidagi 'Renowned for...' - sifatdosh iborasi; ega - 'ancient Persian engineers'. Gap to'liq bo'lishi uchun o'tgan zamondagi mustaqil fe'l 'transformed' kerak. B, D, A variantlari noaniq shakllar (participle, infinitive) bo'lib, kesim bo'la olmaydi (fragment sentence hosil qiladi).
w_b5_11.strat: SAT VERB VS FRAGMENT: Har bir gapda albatta son va zamonga ega bo'lgan mustaqil kesim (finite verb: transformed) bo'lishi shart!

w_b5_12.exp: Osiluvchi aniqlovchi (Dangling modifier): 'Having completed three grueling years of field research...' harakatini dissertatsiya emas, inson bajargan. Shuning uchun verguldan keyin bevosita bu ishni bajargan shaxs - 'Dr. Ramirez' kelishi shart. A, D va B variantlarida ega 'dissertation' yoki 'submission' bo'lib, mantiqiy xato keltirib chiqaradi.
w_b5_12.strat: SAT DANGLING MODIFIER HACK: 'Having completed...' harakatini kim bajardi? Dr. Ramirez! Demak verguldan keyingi 1-so'z 'Dr. Ramirez' bo'lishi shart (C).

w_b5_13.exp: 'Each of the...' konstruktsiyasida asosiy ega 'Each' so'zidir va u har doim birlikda bo'ladi. 'of the ninety-eight student volunteers' predlogli iborasi egaga ta'sir qilmaydi. Shuning uchun o'tgan zamondagi birlik fe'li 'was' to'g'ri. B, D va A ko'plikdagi fe'llardir.
w_b5_13.strat: SAT RULE: 'Each', 'Every', 'Neither', 'Either' bilan boshlangan iboralar har doim BIRLIK (singular: was) fe'lini oladi.

w_b5_14.exp: Garchi Kepler o'tmishda (seventeenth century) yashagan bo'lsa ham, sayyoralarning ellips bo'ylab aylanishi - o'zgarmas tabiiy-ilmiy haqiqat (universal general truth / scientific fact) hisoblanadi. Ilmiy qonuniyatlar va umumiy haqiqatlar ingliz tili grammatikasida har doim Present Simple (revolve) zamonida beriladi. D varianti sayyoralar faqat o'tmishda aylangan degan noto'g'ri ma'no beradi.
w_b5_14.strat: SAT SCIENTIFIC FACT: Doimiy o'zgarmas ilmiy qoidalar va tabiat qonunlari har doim hozirgi zamonda (Present Simple: revolve) yoziladi.

w_b5_15.exp: Olmosh va uning o'rnini bosuvchi so'z moslashuvi (Pronoun-Antecedent Agreement): Bu yerda gap 'Stradivarius violins' (skripkalar - ko'plikdagi ot) haqida bormoqda. Ko'plikdagi otning egalik olmoshi 'their' bo'ladi. A varianti (its) birlikdagi otlar uchun, C (it's = it is) va B (they're = they are) qisqartmalardir.
w_b5_15.strat: SAT PRONOUN-ANTECEDENT: 'violins' (plural) -> 'their resonance'. Ko'plikka nisbatan 'its' ishlatish asosiy tuzoqdir.

w_b5_16.exp: Korrelyativ bog'lovchi va parallellik qoidasi: 'not only [fe'l] ... but also [fe'l]'. 'not only enforce' shakliga parallel ravishda 'but also safeguard' kelishi shart. B, C va A variantlari korrelyativ strukturani buzadi.
w_b5_16.strat: SAT CORRELATIVE CONJUNCTION: 'Not only X ... but also Y'. Agar X fe'lning asosiy shakli (enforce) bo'lsa, Y ham asosiy shakl (safeguard) bo'lishi shart.

w_b5_17.exp: Paralellizm qoidasi: Ro'yxatdagi barcha fe'l shakllari bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi kerak: 1) 'setting up shelters', 2) 'navigating across ice', va 3) 'cooking rations'. Gerundiy (-ing) shakli saqlanishi shart. D (to cook), B (cooked), A (cook) parallellikni buzadi.
w_b5_17.strat: SAT PARALLELISM: setting up..., navigating..., and cooking... Har doim ketma-ketlikdagi -ing shakllarini tenglashtiring.

w_b5_18.exp: Matnda o'tgan zamon ('Early twentieth-century...') bilan hozirgi zamon muhandisligi ('modern aerospace engineers...') o'rtasidagi xronologik qarama-qarshilik ko'rsatilmoqda. 'Today,' o'tgan davrdan hozirgi davrga o'tishni eng mantiqiy tarzda ta'minlaydi. A misol keltirish, D sabab-oqibat, C qayta ta'riflash uchun bo'lib mos kelmaydi.
w_b5_18.strat: SAT CHRONOLOGICAL TRANSITION: 'Early 20th century...' boshlanishi keyingi gapda 'Today,' yoki 'Now,' bilan davom etishini talab qiladi.

w_b5_19.exp: Birinchi gapda ko'plab o'simliklar azotni tayyor o'g'itdan olishi aytiladi. Ikkinchi gapda esa dukkakli o'simliklar aksincha (by contrast), o'g'itsiz ham ildizidagi bakteriyalar yordamida o'zi azot to'play olishi bayon qilinadi. Bu ikki xususiyat o'rtasidagi ziddiyatni 'by contrast' (aksincha) eng to'g'ri bog'laydi.
w_b5_19.strat: SAT CONTRAST TRANSITION: 'Many plants need fertilizers <-> Legumes thrive without synthetic amendments' = By contrast.

w_b5_20.exp: Sabab-oqibat aloqasi: Hujjatlar mog'orlab chirib ketgani (sabab) tufayli, tarixchilar yozuvlarni tiklash uchun maxsus multispektral skanerlardan foydalanishga majbur bo'lishmoqda (oqibat). 'Accordingly' (shunga muvofiq / shu sababli) sababdan oqibatga o'tishni to'g'ri ifodalaydi. C va A ziddiyat bog'lovchilari.
w_b5_20.strat: SAT CAUSE-EFFECT: Hujjatlar chirigan (sabab) -> Accordingly (shu sababli) maxsus texnologiya kerak (oqibat).

w_b5_21.exp: Qo'shimcha ijobiy xususiyat kiritilmoqda (Addition): 1) Yomg'ir suvini yutadi; 2) Qo'shimcha ravishda (Additionally), shahar haroratini pasaytiradi. A va C ziddiyat bildiradi, bu yerda esa ikkita ijobiy samara bir-birini to'ldirmoqda.
w_b5_21.strat: SAT ADDITION TRANSITION: Benefit 1 (absorbs runoff) + Benefit 2 (lowers temperature) -> 'Additionally,'.

w_b5_22.exp: Ziddiyat va kutilmagan haqiqat: Dastlab pichoqlar shu yerning o'zida yasalgan deb o'ylashgan ('initially suggesting local workshop'). Biroq kimyoviy tahlil buning aksini - toshlar 400 mil uzoqdan keltirilganini isbotladi. 'however' dastlabki taxmin bilan haqiqiy kashfiyot o'rtasidagi ziddiyatni ochib beradi.
w_b5_22.strat: SAT CONTRAST: 'initially thought X <-> spectrometry however revealed Y'. Har doim dastlabki taxminga 'however' qarshi qo'yiladi.

w_b5_23.exp: Mitoz va meyoz jarayonlari taqqoslanmoqda: mitoz 2 ta bir xil hujayra hosil qilsa, meyoz aksincha (In contrast) 4 ta turlicha jinsiy hujayra hosil qiladi. Bu aniq biologik qarama-qarshilikdir.
w_b5_23.strat: SAT CONTRAST: Mitosis (2 identical) vs Meiosis (4 diverse) -> 'In contrast,'.

w_b5_24.exp: Birinchi gapda umumiy qoida (ba'zi sahro hayvonlari issiqdan qochib uyquga ketadi) aytiladi. Ikkinchi gapda esa ushbu qoidaga aniq misol sifatida 'spadefoot toad' qurbaqasi keltirilmoqda. Shuning uchun 'for example' (masalan) eng to'g'ri bog'lovchidir.
w_b5_24.strat: SAT EXEMPLIFICATION: General claim (desert organisms evade heat) -> Specific animal (spadefoot toad) = 'for example'.

w_b5_25.exp: Ochiq kod tarafdorlari (kodni ommaga ochish xavfsizlikni oshiradi deydi) bilan xususiy dastur korporatsiyalari (kodni ochish xakerlarga yo'l ochadi deydi) o'rtasidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarama-qarshi pozitsiya bayon qilinmoqda. 'conversely' (aksincha) bu ikki qarashni mukammal bog'laydi.
w_b5_25.strat: SAT DIRECT OPPOSITION: Open-source advocates (public code is safer) vs Proprietary corporations (public code aids hackers) -> 'conversely'.

w_b5_26.exp: Talabaning maqsadi: Lin yodgorligining dastlabki tanqid qilinishi bilan hozirgi yuksak e'tirofi o'rtasidagi ziddiyatni (contrast between initial reception and contemporary standing) ko'rsatish. A varianti 'Although initially criticized... it is now celebrated as one of the most revered monuments' jumlasi bilan aynan shu maqsadni 100% bajaradi.
w_b5_26.strat: SAT RHETORICAL SYNTHESIS HACK: Maqsadga qarang: 'contrast initial reception and contemporary standing'. Kalit: 'Although initially criticized ... now celebrated' (A).

w_b5_27.exp: Talabaning maqsadi: organizm bilan mutlaqo tanish bo'lmagan auditoriyaga tardigradalarni tanishtirish (introduce to unfamiliar audience). D varianti ularning nima ekani (microscopic eight-legged invertebrates), xalq orasidagi nomi (water bears) va asosiy xususiyatini sodda va tushunarli tarzda tanishtiradi.
w_b5_27.strat: SAT GOAL MATCH: 'Introduce to unfamiliar audience' -> nima ekanini ta'riflab beruvchi D varianti eng mukammal kirish.

w_b5_28.exp: Talabaning maqsadi: Svalbardning o'ziga xos xalqaro tijoriy maqomini (unique international commercial status) ta'kidlash. A varianti Norvegiyaning suvereniteti ostida 40 dan ortiq mamlakat fuqarolari bir xil baliq ovlash, ov va konchilik kabi tijoriy huquqlarga egaligini aniq ko'rsatadi. D va C harbiy jihatlarga qaratilgan.
w_b5_28.strat: SAT GOAL FOCUS: Maqsad 'commercial status'. Faqat A variantida 'equal commercial rights to fish, hunt, and mine' aks etgan.

w_b5_29.exp: Talabaning maqsadi: gulning o'ziga xos hidi uning ko'payishiga (reproduction / pollination) qanday xizmat qilishini tushuntirish. D varianti chiriyotgan go'sht hidi o'simlikni changlatuvchi qo'ng'iz va pashshalarni jalb qilishini aniq bog'lab beradi.
w_b5_29.strat: SAT SYNTHESIS GOAL: 'odor facilitates reproduction' -> D variantidagi 'emits odor to lure flies that pollinate' to'liq mos keladi.

w_b5_30.exp: Talabaning maqsadi: davlat/institut skeptitsizmiga qaramay Whittle'ning matonati va tirishqoqligini (perseverance in the face of skepticism) ko'rsatish. B varianti 'Even though the Ministry dismissed it and refused funding, Whittle persevered...' degan ziddiyat orqali maqsadga aniq javob beradi.
w_b5_30.strat: SAT GOAL: 'perseverance in the face of skepticism' -> B: 'Even though Ministry dismissed... Whittle persevered with private backing'.

w_b5_31.exp: Talabaning maqsadi: ildiz tizimining ikkita asosiy ekologik foydasini (dual ecological benefits) ta'kidlash. B varianti 1) to'lqinlarni to'xtatib qirg'oqni himoya qilish va 2) quruqlikdagi o'rmonlardan 4 barobar tezroq uglerod yutish kabi 2 ta foydani birdek ifodalaydi.
w_b5_31.strat: SAT SYNTHESIS GOAL: 'dual benefits' -> B: 'dissipating wave energy AND sequestering carbon'. Ikkala foyda ham qamrab olingan.

w_b5_32.exp: Talabaning maqsadi: kitobning badiiy bezaklari va tasviriy mazmunini (artistic content) tasvirlash. A varianti kitobdagi naqshlar, spirallar, yorqin mineral pigmentlar va hayvonlar tasvirini keltirib, badiiy tomonni to'liq aks ettiradi.
w_b5_32.strat: SAT SYNTHESIS GOAL: 'artistic content' -> naqshlar, ranglar va tasvirlarni ochib beruvchi A varianti yagona to'g'ri tanlovdir.

w_b5_33.exp: Talabaning maqsadi: kalta (semi-dwarf) bug'doyning oddiy baland bug'doyga nisbatan jismoniy ustunligini (physical advantage) tushuntirish. A varianti baland bug'doy don og'irligidan yiqilib tushgani, kalta bug'doy esa poyasi baquvvat bo'lib yiqilmasdan katta hosilni ko'tara olganini taqqoslab beradi.
w_b5_33.strat: SAT SYNTHESIS GOAL: 'physical advantage compared to traditional varieties' -> A variantidagi 'Unlike traditional tall wheat that collapsed, shorter sturdier stalks supported yields' aynan shu ustunlikni tushuntiradi.

m_b6_01.strat: Desmosga \(5(2x-3)-4=3(x+7)+2\) ni kiriting; vertikal chiziq \(x=6\) da kesishadi.

m_b6_02.exp: Multiply the second equation by 3: \(6x-3y=9\). Add to first equation: \((4x+3y)+(6x-3y)=31+9\) ⇒ \(10x=40\) ⇒ \(x=4\). Substitute into \(2(4)-y=3\) ⇒ \(8-y=3\) ⇒ \(y=5\). Therefore, \(x+y=4+5=9\).
m_b6_02.strat: Desmosga ikkala tenglamani yozing va kesishish nuqtasini bosing: (4, 5). So'ralgan \(x+y=4+5=9\).

m_b6_03.exp: Let g be the number of guests. The inequality is \(120+18.50g\le 850\). Subtract 120: \(18.50g\le 730\). Divide by 18.50: \(g\le 39.459\). Since the number of guests must be a whole integer, the maximum number is 39.
m_b6_03.strat: \(\frac{730}{18.50}=39.45\). Hech qachon yuqoriga yaxlitlamang (40 ta 860$ bo'lib byudjetdan oshib ketadi).

m_b6_04.exp: A linear system has no solution if the lines are parallel (identical slopes) but have different y-intercepts. The ratio of coefficients of \(x\) and \(y\) must be equal: \(\frac{6}{2}=-\frac{9}{-k}\) ⇒ \(3=\frac{9}{k}\) ⇒ \(k=3\). Checking intercepts: \(\frac{14}{8}\ne 3\), confirming the lines never intersect.

m_b6_05.exp: When \(m=0\) (the moment descent starts), \(E(0)=480-16(0)=480\) meters. Thus, 480 represents the initial elevation of the drone.
m_b6_05.strat: \(y=mx+b\) da b har doim boshlang'ich qiymat (initial value, at \(m=0\)).

m_b6_06.exp: Case 1: \(3x-5=2x+10\) ⇒ \(x=15\). Check: \(|3(15)-5|=|40|=40\); \(2(15)+10=40\) (Valid positive solution!). Case 2: \(3x-5=-(2x+10)\) ⇒ \(5x=-5\) ⇒ \(x=-1\) (Negative). Thus, the positive solution is 15.
m_b6_06.strat: Desmosga \(y_{1}=|3x-5|\) va \(y_{2}=2x+10\) yozing, musbat kesishish nuqtasi \(x=15\) da joylashgan.

m_b6_07.exp: Test point (5, 0): Inequality 1: \(0>-2(5)+5\) ⇒ \(0>-5\) (True). Inequality 2: \(3(5)-4(0)=15\ge 12\) (True). Both inequalities are satisfied.
m_b6_07.strat: Variantlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tengsizliklarga qo'yib tekshiring (Plugging in choices).

m_b6_08.exp: The slope formula is \(m=\frac{y_{2}-y_{1}}{x_{2}-x_{1}}\). Here, \(-\frac{3}{4}=\frac{k-7}{10-2}\) ⇒ \(-\frac{3}{4}=\frac{k-7}{8}\). Multiply both sides by 8: \(-6=k-7\) ⇒ \(k=1\).
m_b6_08.strat: \(x\) 8 birlik o'ngga surilganda, \(y\) har 4 qadamda 3 ga kamayadi. 8 qadamda 6 ga kamayadi: \(7-6=1\).

m_b6_09.exp: Rewrite \(3x+6y=19\) in slope-intercept form: \(6y=-3x+19\) ⇒ \(y=-\frac{1}{2}\) \(x+\frac{19}{6}\). The slope is \(-\frac{1}{2}\). Perpendicular line L has slope \(m=-\frac{1}{-\frac{1}{2}}=2\). Using point-slope form with (4, \(-2\)): \(y-(-2)=2(x-4)\) ⇒ \(y+2=2x-8\) ⇒ \(y=2x-10\). The y-intercept is \(-10\).
m_b6_09.strat: Perpendikulyar burchak koeffitsiyenti: \(-\frac{1}{m}\)_original. \(-\frac{1}{2}\) ning teskari qarama-qarshisi +2. \(y=2(0)-10=-10\).

m_b6_10.exp: Let V be the total initial volume. After pouring \(\frac{2}{5}\) V, remaining liquid is \(\frac{3}{5}\) V. Pouring \(\frac{1}{3}\) of this leaves \(\frac{2}{3}\) * (3/5 V) = 2/5 V. We are given \(\frac{2}{5}\) \(V=160\) ⇒ \(V=160\cdot \frac{5}{2}=400\) milliliters.
m_b6_10.strat: Qolgan qism: \((1-\frac{2}{5})\cdot (1-\frac{1}{3})=\frac{3}{5}\cdot \frac{2}{3}=\frac{2}{5}\). \(\frac{2}{5}\) qismi 160 bo'lsa, to'liq hajm = \(160\cdot 2.5=400\) ml.

m_b6_11.exp: For infinitely many solutions, the two linear equations must represent identical lines. Multiply the second equation by 3: \(15x-6y=3q\). Comparing with \(px-6y=18\) gives \(p=15\) and \(3q=18\) ⇒ \(q=6\). Thus, \(p\cdot q=15\cdot 6=90\).
m_b6_11.strat: Cheksiz yechim: Tenglamalar bir-birining karralisi bo'lishi shart (\(-\frac{6}{-2}=3\) marta). \(p=5\cdot 3=15\), \(q=\frac{18}{3}=6\). Ko'paytma: \(15\cdot 6=90\).

m_b6_12.exp: The rate is \(\frac{420}{3.5}=120\) documents per minute. In 12 minutes, the total processed is \(120\cdot 12=1{,}440\) documents.

m_b6_13.exp: Slope \(m=\frac{2-(-4)}{3-0}=\frac{6}{3}=2\). The y-intercept is \(b=-4\). The boundary line is \(y=2x-4\). Strictly below means \(y<2x-4\).

m_b6_14.exp: The x-coordinate of the vertex of \(ax^{2}+bx+c\) is \(x=-\frac{b}{2a}=-\frac{-24}{2\cdot 3}=\frac{24}{6}=4\). The minimum value is \(f(4)=3(4)^{2}-24(4)+55=3(16)-96+55=48-96+55=7\).
m_b6_14.strat: Desmosga \(y=3x^{2}-24x+55\) yozing va eng pastki vertex nuqtasini bosing: (4, 7). Minimum qiymat \(y=7\).

m_b6_15.exp: A quadratic equation \(ax^{2}+bx+c=0\) has exactly one real solution when its discriminant \(D=b^{2}-4ac=0\). Here, \(k^{2}-4(4)(49)=0\) ⇒ \(k^{2}-784=0\) ⇒ \(k^{2}=784\). Since \(k>0\), \(k=\sqrt{784}=28\).
m_b6_15.strat: To'la kvadrat qoidasi: \((2x+7)^{2}=4x^{2}+28x+49\). O'rta had \(2\cdot 2x\cdot 7=28x\) bo'lishi kerak ⇒ \(k=28\).

m_b6_16.exp: Square both sides: \(2x+9=(x-3)^{2}\) ⇒ \(2x+9=x^{2}-6x+9\) ⇒ \(x^{2}-8x=0\) ⇒ \(x(x-8)=0\) ⇒ \(x=0\) or \(x=8\). Testing \(x=0\): \(\sqrt{9}=-3\) (False, extraneous root). Testing \(x=8\): \(\sqrt{25}=5\) (True!). Thus, the only real solution is 8.
m_b6_16.strat: Ildizli tenglamani yechgandan so'ng ildizlarni tekshiring: \(x=0\) da \(\sqrt{9}=-3\) bo'la olmaydi. Faqat \(x=8\) to'g'ri.

m_b6_17.exp: The standard form for periodic growth is \(y=a\cdot b^{\frac{t}{k}}\), where a is the initial quantity (350), b is the growth factor (3), and \(k\) is the cycle duration (4 hours). Thus, \(B(t)=350(3)^{\frac{t}{4}}\).
m_b6_17.strat: Tekshirish: \(t=4\) da bir marta 3 ga ko'payishi kerak \((350\cdot 3=1050)\). \(B(4)=350(3)^{\frac{4}{4}}=350\cdot 3=1050\) (Faqat B to'g'ri).

m_b6_18.exp: Factor numerator: \(2x^{2}-x-15=(2x+5)(x-3)\). Factor denominator: \(x^{2}-9=(x-3)(x+3)\). Cancel common factor \((x-3)\): \(\frac{2x+5}{x+3}\).
m_b6_18.strat: Suratni ko'paytuvchilarga ajrating: \((2x+5)(x-3)\). Maxraj: \((x-3)(x+3)\). \((x-3)\) qisqarib \(\frac{2x+5}{x+3}\) qoladi.

m_b6_19.strat: Ildiz \(x=3\) ni funksiyaga qo'ying va 0 ga tenglang: \(27-45+3k-18=0\) ⇒ \(3k=36\) ⇒ \(k=12\).

m_b6_20.exp: Set the equations equal: \(x^{2}-6x+11=2x-c\) ⇒ \(x^{2}-8x+(11+c)=0\). For exactly one solution, discriminant \(D=(-8)^{2}-4(1)(11+c)=0\) ⇒ \(64-44-4c=0\) ⇒ \(20-4c=0\) ⇒ \(c=5\).

m_b6_21.strat: \(64^{\frac{2}{3}}=(4^{3})^{\frac{2}{3}}=4^{2}=16\). Faqat C yoki A bo'lishi mumkin. \(x\) darajasi \(6\cdot \frac{2}{3}=4\) bo'ladi ⇒ C.

m_b6_22.exp: A horizontal shift \(c\) units to the right replaces \(x\) with \((x-c)\), giving \((x-5)^{2}\). A vertical shift d units down subtracts d from the function, giving \((x-5)^{2}-3\).

m_b6_23.exp: Using Vieta's formulas: \(r+s=-\frac{-15}{3}=5\), and \(r\cdot s=\frac{7}{3}\). Note that \(\frac{1}{r}+\frac{1}{s}=\frac{r+s}{r\cdot s}=\frac{5}{\frac{7}{3}}=5\cdot \frac{3}{7}=\frac{15}{7}\).

m_b6_24.exp: In an exponential decay model \(y=a(1-r)^{t}\), the base is \(1-r\). Here, \(1-r=0.88\) ⇒ \(r=1-0.88=0.12\), which represents an annual decrease of 12%.

m_b6_25.exp: The ball strikes the ground when \(h(t)=0\): \(-16t^{2}+64t+80=0\). Divide both sides by \(-16\): \(t^{2}-4t-5=0\). Factor: \((t-5)(t+1)=0\). Since time \(t\ge 0\), \(t=5\) seconds.

m_b6_28.exp: Let P be the 2020 population. In 2022, it was 1.25P. In 2024, after a 20% decrease, it was \((1-0.20)(1.25P)=0.80\cdot 1.25P=1.00P\). Since P_\(2024=1{,}200\), the 2020 population was exactly 1,200.
m_b6_28.strat: \(1.25\cdot 0.80=1.00\)! Ya'ni +25% va \(-20\)% bir-birini to'liq neytrallaydi. Boshlang'ich son 1,200 bo'lgan.

m_b6_29.exp: Total sum required for 5 exams with a mean of 86 is \(5\cdot 86=430\). The sum of the first 4 exams is \(82+88+91+79=340\). The fifth exam score must be \(430-340=90\).

m_b6_30.exp: The margin of error gives a plausible interval for the population parameter: 54% +/\(-4\)% = [50%, 58%]. It does not guarantee certainty ('exactly' or 'guaranteed'). Hence, D is the only statistically sound interpretation.
m_b6_30.strat: Statistika qoidasi: 'Guaranteed' yoki 'Exactly' so'zlari noto'g'ri. Har doim 'plausible' (ehtimoliy oraliq) to'g'ri bo'ladi.

m_b6_31.exp: Since 1 foot = 12 inches, 1 square foot = \(12^{2}=144\) square inches. Convert the area: 54 sq in * (1 sq ft / 144 sq in) = \(\frac{54}{144}=\frac{3}{8}=0.375\) square feet.
m_b6_31.strat: Kvadrat birliklar tuzog'i! 12 ga emas, \(12^{2}=144\) ga bo'linadi: \(\frac{54}{144}=0.375\).

m_b6_32.exp: The condition specifies selecting 'from those who reported symptom relief'. Total patients reporting relief = 128 (Treatment A) + 36 (Placebo) = 164. The favorable count from Treatment A is 128. Therefore, \(P=\frac{128}{164}\).
m_b6_32.strat: Shartli ehtimollik: Maxrajda faqat shart qanoatlantirganlar (yengillik sezganlar): \(128+36=164\). Ehtimollik: \(\frac{128}{164}\).

m_b6_33.exp: Total parts = \(14+3+1=18\) parts. Weight of 1 part = 72 kg / \(18=4\) kg. Tin represents 3 parts: \(3\cdot 4\) kg = 12 kg.
m_b6_33.strat: Jami qismlar: \(14+3+1=18\). Bitta qism = \(\frac{72}{18}=4\) kg. Qalay (tin) = \(3\cdot 4=12\) kg.

m_b6_34.exp: Adding a constant \(c\) to every value in a dataset shifts the entire distribution rightward by \(c\) (so the median increases by \(c=6\)), but the distances between points remain completely identical, meaning the spread (standard deviation) is unchanged.
m_b6_34.strat: Har bir elementga son qo'shilganda: Median o'zgaradi \((+6)\), lekin dispersiya/standart og'ish o'zgarmaydi.

m_b6_35.exp: Substitute \(x=9.5\) into the equation: \(y=4.2(9.5)+48=39.9+48=87.9\). Rounding to the nearest whole point gives 88.

m_b6_36.exp: Because they travel in opposite directions, their separation speed is the sum: \(65+85=150\) miles per hour. Time needed to separate 450 miles = \(\frac{450}{150}=3\) hours. Adding 3 hours to 08:00 AM gives 11:00 AM.
m_b6_36.strat: Qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda tezliklar qo'shiladi: \(65+85=150\) mph. Vaqt = \(\frac{450}{150}=3\) soat. 08:\(00+3\):\(00=11\):00 AM.

m_b6_38.exp: P(at least one defect) = \(1-P\)(no defects). The probability that a component has no defect is \(1-0.04=0.96\). For 2 independent components: P(no defects) = \(0.96\cdot 0.96=0.9216\). Thus, P(at least one defect) = \(1-0.9216=0.0784\).

m_b6_39.exp: Volume of prism = length * width * height = \(8\cdot 5\cdot 4=160\) cm^3. Mass = density * volume = 4.5 g/cm^\(3\cdot 160\) cm^\(3=720\) grams.

m_b6_40.exp: In any right triangle where angles A and B are complementary acute angles (\(A+B=90\) degrees), the co-function identity holds: \(\sin(A)=\cos(90-A)=\cos(B)\). Therefore, \(\cos(B)=\frac{5}{13}\).
m_b6_40.strat: O'zaro to'ldiruvchi burchaklar qoidasi: \(\sin(A)=\cos(B)\). Sinus berilgan bo'lsa, ikkinchi burchak kosinusi unga teng: \(\frac{5}{13}\).

m_b6_41.exp: Arc length s is given by \(s=r\) * theta when theta is in radians. Here, \(s=18\cdot (5\cdot \frac{\pi }{6})=3\cdot 5\cdot \pi =15\cdot \pi\) centimeters.

m_b6_42.exp: Standard form is \((x-h)^{2}+(y-k)^{2}=r^{2}\). Comparing gives \(h=-7\), \(k=4\), and \(r=\sqrt{144}=12\). Therefore, \(h+k+r=-7+4+12=9\).

m_b6_43.exp: Volume of a cylinder is \(V=\pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h\). For Cylinder Q, V_\(Q=\pi \cdot (2r)^{2}\cdot (\frac{h}{2})=\pi \cdot (4r^{2})\cdot (\frac{h}{2})=2\cdot (\pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h)=2\cdot V\)_P. Thus, V_\(Q=2\cdot 45\cdot \pi =90\cdot \pi\) cubic inches.
m_b6_43.strat: Radius kvadratik ta'sir qiladi \((2^{2}=4)\), balandlik esa chiziqli \((\frac{1}{2})\). Umumiy hajm \(4\cdot \frac{1}{2}=2\) barobar oshadi: \(45\cdot \pi \cdot 2=90\cdot \pi\).

m_b6_44.exp: In a 30-60-90 special right triangle with hypotenuse 2x, the side opposite the 30-degree angle is \(x\), and the side opposite the 60-degree angle is \(x\cdot \sqrt{3}\). Here, hypotenuse = 16 ⇒ \(x=8\). Side opposite 60 degrees is \(8\cdot \sqrt{3}\).

m_b6_45.exp: The ratio of corresponding side lengths is \(k=\frac{25}{15}=\frac{5}{3}\). The ratio of their areas is \(k^{2}=\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^{2}=\frac{25}{9}\). Thus, Area(DEF) = \(72\cdot (\frac{25}{9})=8\cdot 25=200\) square centimeters.
m_b6_45.strat: Yuzalar nisbati chiziqli nisbatning kvadrati: \(\left(\frac{25}{15}\right)^{2}=\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^{2}=\frac{25}{9}\). \(72\cdot \frac{25}{9}=200\) sm^2.

m_b6_46.exp: Sector area formula: Area = (theta / 360) * pi * \(r\)^2. Here, \((\frac{72}{360})\cdot \pi \cdot r^{2}=20\cdot \pi\) ⇒ \(\frac{1}{5}\cdot r^{2}=20\) ⇒ \(r^{2}=100\) ⇒ \(r=10\). The circumference is \(C=2\cdot \pi \cdot r=2\cdot \pi \cdot (10)=20\cdot \pi\) centimeters.
m_b6_46.strat: Sektor yuzi: \((\frac{72}{360})\cdot \pi \cdot r^{2}=20\cdot \pi\) ⇒ \(r^{2}=100\) ⇒ \(r=10\). Aylana uzunligi \(C=2\cdot \pi \cdot r=20\cdot \pi\).

m_b6_47.exp: Since \(y=8\) is a horizontal tangent line at (5, 8), the radius at this point is vertical, so the x-coordinate of the center is 5. The circle passes through (5, 8) and (5, 0), so the diameter endpoints along \(x=5\) are (5, 8) and (5, 0). The diameter is \(8-0=8\), meaning radius \(r=4\) and center is at (5, 4). The equation is \((x-5)^{2}+(y-4)^{2}=16\).
m_b6_47.strat: Diametr \(x=5\) bo'ylab (5,8) dan (5,0) gacha ⇒ uzunligi 8 ⇒ radius \(r=4\), \(r^{2}=16\), markaz (5, 4).

m_b6_48.exp: By the Exterior Angle Theorem, the measure of an exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the measures of the two non-adjacent interior angles: angle PRS = angle P + angle \(Q=58+64=122\) degrees.
m_b6_48.strat: Tashqi burchak xossasi: Tashqi burchak o'ziga qo'shni bo'lmagan ikki ichki burchak yig'indisiga teng: \(58+64=122^{\circ}\).

m_b6_49.strat: Pifagor uchligi: Delta_\(x=8\), Delta_\(y=6\) ⇒ 6-8-10 uchburchagi! Masofa 10.

m_b6_50.exp: Using the Pythagorean triple 7-24-25, if the adjacent side is 24 and the hypotenuse is 25, the opposite side is \(\sqrt{25^{2}-24^{2}}=\sqrt{625-576}=\sqrt{49}=7\). Therefore, \(tan\)(theta) = opposite / adjacent = \(\frac{7}{24}\).
m_b6_50.strat: 7-24-25 Pifagor uchligi. cos = \(\frac{24}{25}\) bo'lsa, sin = \(\frac{7}{25}\). tan = sin/cos = \(\frac{\frac{7}{25}}{\frac{24}{25}}=\frac{7}{24}\).

r_b6_01.exp: The text discusses fragile manuscripts degraded by humidity that need to be preserved without damaging the parchment itself. 'Physical' correctly describes the material condition and structure of the parchment.
r_b6_01.strat: Kontekst kaliti: 'fragile', 'degraded by humidity', 'parchment' (moddiy ashyo). Faqat 'physical' mos keladi.

r_b6_02.exp: 'Far from being embraced' and 'suspected hidden corporate motives' signal strong distrust and doubt. 'Skepticism' precisely matches this attitude of doubt and suspicion.
r_b6_02.strat: Ziddiyat kaliti: 'Far from being embraced' + 'suspected hidden motives' => shubha va ishonchsizlik (skepticism).

r_b6_03.exp: The contrast set up by 'not an exact retrieval of static files but rather...' requires a word opposite to rigid and static. 'Malleable' (easily influenced, adaptable, flexible) accurately characterizes a process that reconstructs events anew each time.
r_b6_03.strat: Qarama-qarshilik: 'rigid/static' ga zid so'z kerak. 'Malleable' (o'zgaruvchan, egiluvchan) to'liq mos keladi.

r_b6_04.exp: To verify authenticity, a researcher wants independent evidence to confirm and support the initial scientific findings. 'Corroborate' means to confirm or give support to a statement or finding.
r_b6_04.strat: 'Verify authenticity' uchun dalillarni bir-biri bilan tasdiqlash (corroborate) talab etiladi.

r_b6_05.exp: 'Despite his reputation for dense and convoluted... distilling intricate doctrines into clear, accessible prose' indicates that in public lectures he was exceptionally clear and easy to understand. 'Lucid' means expressed clearly; easy to understand.
r_b6_05.strat: Ziddiyat: 'dense and convoluted' ga qarama-qarshi so'z 'clear, accessible' => 'lucid' (ravshan, tushunarli).

r_b6_06.exp: Contextual clues 'exhibiting significant rust and structural weakness' directly point to physical degradation and worsening condition. 'Deteriorate' means to become progressively worse.

r_b6_07.exp: The presence of 'conflicting political agendas' making agreement difficult indicates an endeavor marked by dispute and argument. 'Contentious' means causing or likely to cause an argument; controversial.
r_b6_07.strat: 'Conflicting agendas' sababli jarayon munozarali va nizoli (contentious) bo'ladi.

r_b6_08.exp: The text explains that white noise makes minor imperfections and sudden sounds 'imperceptible' (unable to be noticed). 'Mask' means to conceal, disguise, or cover up auditory stimuli.
r_b6_08.strat: Natija: 'imperceptible' qilish uchun shovqinni 'mask' qilish (yopish, bildirmaslik) kerak.

r_b6_09.exp: The following clause clarifies: 'arguing that exaggeration diminishes the genuine significance...'. 'Hyperbolize' means to exaggerate, directly mirroring the context.

r_b6_10.exp: The sentence contrasts superficial critics with perceptive scholars who see that the technique is fundamentally tied and essential to portraying the protagonist's psychology. 'Integral' means necessary to make a whole complete; essential.
r_b6_10.strat: Qarama-qarshilik: 'mere posturing' ga qarshi o'laroq, bu uslub qahramon ruhiyatiga uzviy bog'liq ('integral').

r_b6_11.exp: Sentence 1 introduces the longstanding assumption. Sentence 2 introduces recent empirical findings ('However, recent deep-sea...'). Sentence 3 synthesizes these findings to propose a revised functional explanation. Choice A accurately captures this three-part structural progression.
r_b6_11.strat: Tuzilish qolipi: 1) Eski qarash ('For decades assumed') -> 2) Yangi kashfiyot ('However, recent discovery') -> 3) Yangilangan xulosa ('This suggests').

r_b6_12.exp: The text focuses on Mumford's critique: architects intended to bring sunlight inside (intended benefit), but glare forced the use of blinds and artificial lights (unexpected drawback). Choice C directly summarizes this purpose.
r_b6_12.strat: Matnning asosiy maqsadi: Mumfordning kutilgan maqsad (quyosh nuri) va kutilmagan salbiy natija (sun'iy yorug'lik) haqidagi tahlilini yoritish.

r_b6_13.exp: The first sentence presents the basic, simplified overview ('is often summarized simply as...'), allowing the second sentence to contrast it with the true two-stage intricacy. Thus, it establishes a simplified baseline.
r_b6_13.strat: Funktsiya: Sodda umumiy formulani berish, so'ngra jarayonning asl murakkabligini ochib berish.

r_b6_14.exp: The text explains how behavioral economics incorporated psychological realism (like loss aversion) to improve the unrealistic 'rational actor' assumption and create models that better mirror real behavior.
r_b6_14.strat: Asosiy g'oya: Psixologik tushunchalar an'anaviy iqtisodiy modellarni qanday takomillashtirgani.

r_b6_15.exp: The author points out that Chaucer used unreliable narrators in the 14th century, which challenges the idea that complexity is strictly a modern invention, thereby establishing that it has a deeper history.
r_b6_15.strat: Xulosa kaliti: 'challenges the teleological narrative that narrative complexity arose solely with modernism' => Ishonchsiz roviy modernizmdan ancha oldin mavjud bo'lgan.

r_b6_16.exp: First half: trackways preserve dynamic behavior (advantage over bones). Second half ('However...'): sediment moisture changes how tracks look, making classification difficult (environmental complication). Choice A matches perfectly.
r_b6_16.strat: Birinchi qism: izlarning ustunligi (behavioral interactions); Ikkinchi qism: namlik tufayli yuzaga keladigan qiyinchilik (complication).

r_b6_17.exp: The first sentence explains temperature reduction (benefit 1). The second sentence starts with 'Furthermore' and introduces habitat for pollinators (benefit 2). Thus, it introduces an additional ecological benefit.
r_b6_17.strat: 'Furthermore' ulovchisi yangi qo'shimcha ijobiy jihat (additional benefit) qo'shilishini bildiradi.

r_b6_18.exp: The critics argue that the premise of a 'singular, uncontested consensus' is untenable because historical debates actually involved 'a cacophony of competing compromises'. Hence, there was no single unified meaning.
r_b6_18.strat: Tanqidchilar da'vosi: Mualliflarning o'zi bitta yakdil fikrda bo'lmagan, ko'plab o'zaro murosalardan iborat bo'lgan.

r_b6_19.exp: Text 2 concedes Text 1's main claim ('While geothermal facilities generate reliable baseload electricity...'), but immediately introduces limitations (geographic constraints, seismic risks, permitting hurdles). Choice D captures this nuanced reaction.
r_b6_19.strat: Cross-text mantiqi: Text 2 Text 1 ning afzalligini tan oladi ('reliable'), lekin xatarlari va cheklovlarini ko'rsatadi ('seismic risks, geographic constraints').

r_b6_20.exp: Text 1 advocates for direct teacher lectures as foundational, while Text 2 argues that passive lectures fail and collaborative experiential learning yields higher retention. The central debate is between lecture-based instruction vs collaborative experiential learning.
r_b6_20.strat: Asosiy qarama-qarshilik: Text 1 (o'qituvchi ma'ruzasi/direct lecture) vs Text 2 (hamkorlikdagi tajriba/experiential learning).

r_b6_21.exp: Text 2 does not claim Ricardo's logic was mathematically erroneous; rather, it highlights that real-world shocks create 'perilous vulnerability' when nations specialize completely, exposing them to catastrophic disruptions.
r_b6_21.strat: Bo'rttirilgan variantlarni rad eting ('mathematically flawed', 'universally rejected'). Text 2 kutilmagan uzilishlar xatarini ko'rsatmoqda.

r_b6_22.exp: Text 2 explicitly states that resources spent on resurrection 'would yield far greater biodiversity returns if allocated toward protecting existing endangered species'. This financial/resource trade-off (opportunity cost) is absent in Text 1.
r_b6_22.strat: Yangi dalil kaliti: Text 2 mablag'ni mavjud yo'qolib borayotgan turlarni saqlashga yo'naltirish (opportunity cost) masalasini ko'taradi.

r_b6_23.exp: Text 1 states 'Electric vehicles eliminate direct tailpipe greenhouse emissions', and Text 2 begins 'While electric cars eliminate tailpipe exhaust...'. Both agree that at the point of vehicle operation, there are no tailpipe emissions.
r_b6_23.strat: Umumiy kelishuv nuqtasi: Ikkala matn ham EV avtomobillari quvuridan chiqindi chiqmasligini (zero tailpipe emissions) tasdiqlaydi.

r_b6_24.exp: Text 1 praises digital access and democratization. Text 2 qualifies this by pointing out what is lost in digital scans: texture, watermarks, ink tone (material blind spots that affect historical interpretation).
r_b6_24.strat: Cheklov: Text 2 raqamli nusxalarda qog'oz teksturasi, siyoh nozikliklari yo'qolib, tarixiy tahlilga zarar yetishi mumkinligini aytadi.

r_b6_25.exp: Text 1 argues space agencies should prioritize crewed missions due to human adaptability. Text 2 argues robotic missions should be prioritized due to lower costs, safety, and longevity. The fundamental disagreement is human vs robotic priority.
r_b6_25.strat: Ixtilof nuqtasi: Mars tadqiqotida odamlar (crewed) yoki robotlar (robotic rovers) ustuvor bo'lishi kerakligi.

r_b6_26.exp: The text explains that fungal networks allow mature trees to share sugars with shaded saplings in exchange for minerals, demonstrating mutual cooperation rather than pure competition. Choice C accurately captures this central idea.
r_b6_26.strat: Asosiy g'oya: daraxtlar bir-biri bilan qo'ziqorin to'rlari orqali ozuqa almashadi va hamkorlik qiladi (cooperative dimension).

r_b6_27.exp: The text explicitly states that isotope analysis showed tin came from places as far as Central Asia and Cornwall, 'proving that Bronze Age trade networks were far more intercontinental than previously believed.'
r_b6_27.strat: Matndan aniq fakt: 'trade networks were far more intercontinental than previously believed' => B.

r_b6_28.exp: The text explains that whistled languages compress acoustic energy into 1-4 kHz frequencies, minimizing echoes against canyon walls to communicate across valleys up to 5 miles wide (intelligible communication across rugged terrain).
r_b6_28.strat: Asosiy funktsiya: tog'li va keng hududlarda 5 milgacha ovozli axborotni uzatish.

r_b6_29.exp: The passage states that expecting higher future prices, consumers 'accelerated major purchases rather than postponing them', which front-loaded demand and intensified price pressures. Choice D captures this dynamic precisely.
r_b6_29.strat: Mexanizm: Narxlar yana oshadi deb hozirdan ommaviy xarid qilish talabni oshirib, inflatsiyani battar kuchaytiradi.

r_b6_30.exp: The text directly states that when facing desiccation, they enter 'anhydrobiosis, expelling nearly all cellular water and replacing it with specialized protective proteins' while metabolic activity drops to undetectable levels.
r_b6_30.strat: Matndagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri dalil: 'anhydrobiosis, replacing water with protective proteins'.

r_b6_31.exp: The passage explains that dense materials (asphalt, concrete, dark rooftops) absorb solar thermal energy during the day and re-radiate it, keeping nighttime temperatures elevated.
r_b6_31.strat: Sabab: asfalt va beton kunduzi issiqlikni yutib, kechasi chiqarishi (absorb and re-radiate).

r_b6_32.exp: The text states that in the 1930s Modern Synthesis, mathematical geneticists proved that continuous variation can arise from additive combinations of discrete Mendelian alleles under gradual natural selection.
r_b6_32.strat: Tarixiy yechim: Mendel genlari (discrete alleles) va Darvinning asta-sekin tanlanishi (gradual selection) matematik birlashtirilgan.

r_b6_33.exp: The text states al-Tusi developed the Tusi couple 'to resolve mechanical contradictions' in Ptolemy's models 'without abandoning observational fidelity'. Choice A matches this purpose directly.
r_b6_33.strat: 'Tusi couple' maqsadi: Ptolemey modellaridagi geometrik va mexanik ziddiyatlarni bartaraf etish.

r_b6_34.exp: The hypothesis is that zebra mussels selectively eat green algae and reject toxic cyanobacteria. The cell counts showed a 78% drop in green algae and zero change in cyanobacteria, which directly confirms this selective consumption.
r_b6_34.strat: Gipotezani tasdiqlovchi dalil: Yaxshi suv o'tlarini yeb (78% reduction), zaharli sianobakteriyalarga tegmadi (untouched).

r_b6_35.exp: The callers take personal risk to alert genetic kin, but remain quiet around non-relatives. This fits the evolutionary principle of kin selection: protecting shared genes justifies individual risk. Choice D is the only logically sound conclusion.
r_b6_35.strat: Mantiqiy xulosa: Faqat qarindoshlar (genetic kin) yonida ogohlantirish signali berilishi qarindoshlik tanlanishi (kin selection) bilan izohlanadi.

r_b6_36.exp: Dr. Mendez claims hillside deforestation caused soil erosion that ruined farmland BEFORE the drought started. Finding eroded hillside silt layers deposited decades before the drought provides concrete physical evidence for Mendez's timeline.
r_b6_36.strat: Mendez dalili: qurg'oqchilikdan oldin (decades prior) tuproq eroziyasi sodir bo'lganini isbotlovchi cho'kindi qatlamlari (eroded silt).

r_b6_37.exp: The text establishes that chemosynthetic life requires hydrothermal vents/minerals and zero sunlight. Therefore, an icy planet with geothermal vents beneath lightless ice could theoretically support chemosynthetic life. Choice B is the direct logical deduction.
r_b6_37.strat: Mantiqiy davom: Quyosh nuri yo'q joyda ham xemotrof bakteriyalar yashay oladi => quyoshsiz hayot mavjud bo'lishi mumkin.

r_b6_38.exp: If the endowment effect appears 'within seconds of receiving it' (before emotional attachment can develop), it demonstrates that the higher valuation is caused by immediate aversion to losing possession, rather than time-based sentimental bonding.
r_b6_38.strat: Oniy yo'qotishdan qo'rqish: bir necha soniyada (within seconds) sotish narxini xaridor narxidan 2 barobar yuqori qo'yish.

r_b6_39.exp: By closing stomata by day to prevent water loss and only taking in CO2 at night, succulents sacrifice fast daytime CO2 intake to prioritize survival and water retention in arid conditions.
r_b6_39.strat: Mantiq: Kunduzi barg teshiklarini yopib turish suvni saqlashni birinchi o'ringa qo'yishni (water conservation) anglatadi.

r_b6_40.exp: The hypothesis links sleep spindle density with motor memory consolidation. If participants with more spindles show significantly higher speed/accuracy upon retesting, it directly supports the hypothesis.
r_b6_40.strat: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'liqlik: Ko'proq uyqu spindillari = harakat xotirasining sezilarli darajada yaxshilanishi (speed and accuracy improvements).

r_b6_41.exp: The passage states that this specific chemical disequilibrium suggests ongoing biological replenishing. In astrobiology, such a chemical signature is considered a strong potential biosignature that merits further study. It does not 'prove conclusively' (which is too extreme).
r_b6_41.strat: SAT qoidasi: 'Proves conclusively' kabi mutlaq so'zlardan qoching. 'Serves as a compelling potential biosignature' to'g'ri ilmiy xulosa.

r_b6_42.exp: Dr. Patel's claim is that migration accelerates phonetic vowel drift. Finding that decades with the highest migration rates coincided with the most rapid shifts in vowel formants provides direct empirical correlation.
r_b6_42.strat: Korrelatsiya: Migratsiya eng yuqori bo'lgan davrlarda unli tovushlarning eng tez o'zgarishi qayd etilgan.

r_b6_43.exp: The plants with rhizobacteria grew more roots and survived drought better while using less synthetic fertilizer. This shows they enhance root development and efficiency while decreasing synthetic fertilizer needs.
r_b6_43.strat: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri xulosa: rizobakteriyalar ildizni o'stiradi va kimyoviy o'g'itga ehtiyojni kamaytiradi.

r_b6_44.exp: If birds that are prevented from caching seeds do NOT show the hippocampus volume increase, it proves that the act and need of caching triggers this brain growth.
r_b6_44.strat: Nazorat guruhi: Ozuqa yashirishdan mahrum qilingan qushlarda miya kattalashmagan bo'lsa, bu gipotezani to'liq isbotlaydi.

r_b6_45.exp: Bleached corals can only survive a few weeks on plankton alone and cannot sustain themselves long-term without algae. If warm water persists for months, they will starve and die.
r_b6_45.strat: Mantiqiy zanjir: Suvo'tsiz bir necha hafta yashay oladi -> Issiqlik oylab davom etsa -> ochlikdan nobud bo'ladi (mortality).

r_b6_46.exp: Dr. Thorne's hypothesis is that calcium carbonate scale prevented lead from leaching into drinking water. Finding low lead levels in water whenever dense calcium scale lined the pipes directly validates this barrier mechanism.
r_b6_46.strat: Gipoteza tasdig'i: Qalin mineral qatlam (calcium scale) bo'lgan quvurlarda suvda qo'rg'oshin miqdori xavfsiz darajada past bo'lgan.

r_b6_47.exp: Ostrom proved that communities with self-monitoring and clear rules managed resources for centuries without depletion. Thus, depletion is not inevitable if effective collective self-governance exists.
r_b6_47.strat: Ostrom xulosasi: 'Fojia' muqarrar emas (not inevitable); jamoaviy qoidalar bo'lsa umumiy resursni asrab qolish mumkin.

r_b6_48.exp: The hypothesis is that oyster reefs improve water clarity. B 65% increase in light-penetration depth (water clarity) in restored inlets vs control inlets directly proves the effect.
r_b6_48.strat: Gipoteza: suv tiniqlashishi (clarity). Dalil: yorug'lik o'tish chuqurligining 65% ga oshishi (light-penetration depth).

r_b6_49.exp: When cold weather stops bees from flying, plants that can self-pollinate still produce seeds. Thus, self-pollination acts as 'reproductive insurance' against bad weather.
r_b6_49.strat: Mantiqiy xulosa: O'z-o'zidan changlanish noqulay ob-havoda sug'urta (insurance policy) vazifasini bajaradi.

r_b6_50.exp: Dr. Zhang's hypothesis claims both languages remain active simultaneously and prefrontal inhibition is required. fMRI scans showing involuntary L1 activations and elevated prefrontal activity during L2 speech directly confirm both parts of the hypothesis.
r_b6_50.strat: Ikki tomonlama isbot: fMRI orqali bir vaqtning o'zida L1 so'zlarining faollashishi va miya boshqaruv markazining zo'riqishi (prefrontal cortex activity).

w_b8_01.exp: The first sentence establishes a problem (mechanical clocks losing or gaining time due to temperature fluctuations). The second describes the technological solution developed in response. 'Consequently' logically connects the cause/problem to its resulting solution.
w_b8_01.strat: Sabab-oqibat bog'lanishi: Soatlar harorat tufayli adashardi -> Shu sababli (Consequently) haroratni kompensatsiya qiluvchi mexanizm yaratildi.

w_b8_02.exp: The first sentence introduces one adaptation (compact rosettes); the second introduces another complementary adaptation (dense root structures). 'Furthermore' correctly marks an additive continuation.
w_b8_02.strat: Qo'shimcha ma'lumot (Addition): Alp o'simliklarining ikki foydali xususiyati birin-ketin keltirilmoqda. 'Furthermore' to'g'ri.

w_b8_03.exp: The first sentence states an optimistic prediction. The second reveals empirical survey results that contradict that prediction. 'However' establishes the needed contrast.
w_b8_03.strat: Kutilma va amaliyot ziddiyati: Samokatlar avtomobil o'rnini bosadi deb kutilgan, lekin (However) piyodalar o'rnini egalladi.

w_b8_04.exp: The first sentence states what vent organisms cannot do. The second presents the alternative mechanism they actually use. 'Instead' signals an alternative in place of the negated option.
w_b8_04.strat: Inkor va muqobil yechim: 'cannot rely...' keyin nima qilishi aytilganda 'Instead' (uning o'rniga) to'g'ri keladi.

w_b8_05.exp: The sentence shifts chronologically from an ongoing past debate ('long debated') to the current empirical consensus established by recent studies. 'Today,' marks this temporal transition.
w_b8_05.strat: Vaqt zanjiri (Past -> Present): O'tmishdagi uzoq bahslardan hozirgi kun xulosasiga o'tishda 'Today,' qo'llaniladi.

w_b8_06.exp: The first sentence provides a general claim about cognitive adaptability in birds. The second illustrates this claim with a specific species. 'For instance,' marks exemplification.
w_b8_06.strat: Umumiy fikrga misol: Qushlarning moslashuvi aytilgach, Yangi Kaledoniya qarg'asi misol keltirilyapti ('for instance').

w_b8_07.exp: The threat of particulate damage directly causes chipmakers to build cleanrooms with positive pressure. 'Thus' signals this cause-and-effect link.
w_b8_07.strat: Natija ko'rsatkichi: Chang chiplarni buzadi, shuning uchun / demak (Thus) toza xonalar quriladi.

w_b8_08.exp: The text contrasts two different historical painting techniques: adding egg yolk vs. avoiding egg emulsions altogether to create pure layered glazes. 'Conversely' introduces this contrasting method.
w_b8_08.strat: Teskari usul (Contrast): Bir guruh rassomlar tuxum sarig'i qo'shgan bo'lsa, Flamand ustalari aksincha (Conversely) sof moy ishlatgan.

w_b8_09.exp: Operating at millikelvin temperatures is mandatory; if this condition is not met, thermal noise causes decoherence. 'Otherwise' expresses the adverse consequence of failing to meet the condition.
w_b8_09.strat: Aks holda (Otherwise): Harorat o'ta past bo'lishi shart, aks holda (Otherwise) issiqlik shovqini hisoblashni yo'q qiladi.

w_b8_10.exp: Linguistic evidence supports the shared culture theory; mythological evidence independently reinforces it. 'Moreover' marks this additive, corroborating line of evidence.
w_b8_10.strat: Dalil ustiga dalil (Addition): Tilshunoslik dalili yetmagandek, bundan tashqari (Moreover) mifologik dalillar ham bor.

w_b8_11.exp: The discovery overturned the long-held anthropological dogma that monumental construction required agriculture. 'Surprisingly,' introduces this unexpected, paradigm-shifting finding.
w_b8_11.strat: Kutilmagan burilish: Eskirgan qarashga qarshi kutilmagan haqiqat chiqqanda 'Surprisingly' (Hayratlanarli tomoni) to'g'ri bo'ladi.

w_b8_12.exp: Higher UV radiation causes DNA degradation in phytoplankton. 'As a result,' correctly specifies the causal effect.
w_b8_12.strat: Sabab-oqibat (as a result): UV radiatsiyasining oshishi oqibatida fitoplanktonlar shikastlanadi.

w_b8_13.exp: The passage contrasts orderly laminar flow with chaotic turbulent flow at high velocities. 'However,' establishes the contrast.
w_b8_13.strat: Holat o'zgarishi: Tartibli silliq oqimdan notinch turbulent oqimga o'tishda 'however' (ammo) ziddiyatni bildiradi.

w_b8_14.exp: The text lists two distinct benefits: summer cooling and winter passive heating. 'Additionally,' connects the second benefit to the first.
w_b8_14.strat: Foydalarni sanash (Addition): Yozgi soya + Qishki quyosh nuri ('Additionally').

w_b8_15.exp: The auction formats appear completely different, yet mathematically they yield identical revenue. 'Yet,' conveys this counter-intuitive reality.
w_b8_15.strat: Tashqi ko'rinish vs Haqiqat ziddiyati: Shakli turlicha ko'ringani bilan, lekin (Yet,) matematik kutilmasi bir xil.

w_b8_16.exp: Choice D directly addresses the prompt's specific goal (emphasizing the historical significance of the discovery) by noting it was the very first direct chemical detection of an exoplanetary atmosphere.
w_b8_16.strat: Talab qilingan maqsad: 'historical significance of Charbonneau's discovery'. Variant D 'marking the first direct chemical detection' bilan aynan shu maqsadga javob beradi.

w_b8_17.exp: Choice B explicitly explains the comparative mechanism (tooth enamel for childhood vs. bone tissue for adulthood) to show how migration during a lifetime is determined.
w_b8_17.strat: Maqsadni qidiring: 'explain how ... determines whether an individual migrated'. Variant B enamel (bolalik) va suyak (yaqin davr) taqqoslashini tushuntirib beradi.

w_b8_18.exp: The prompt asks to contrast the interpretations of the two historians. Choice C contrasts Bovill's view (salt) with Levtzion's view (gold).
w_b8_18.strat: Maqsad: 'contrast the historical interpretations'. Variant C 'While Bovill... Levtzion argued...' orqali ikkala qarashni taqqoslaydi.

w_b8_19.exp: Choice B highlights Yonath's specific technical breakthrough (cryogenic cooling techniques that stabilized ribosomal crystals for imaging).
w_b8_19.strat: Maqsad: 'emphasize Ada Yonath's specific technical breakthrough'. Variant B aynan texnik ixtironi (kriogenik sovutish) ko'rsatadi.

w_b8_20.exp: Choice A synthesizes both required elements: diversity (world's greatest diversity, >70 species) and ecological vulnerability (confined to isolated peaks threatened by warming/drying).
w_b8_20.strat: Ikkita talab: 'diversity' VA 'ecological vulnerability'. Faqat A variant har ikkala omilni o'zida birlashtirgan.

w_b8_21.exp: Choice A directly explains why aerogel was essential: it safely slowed cometary grains without altering them, whereas traditional surfaces would pulverize them.
w_b8_21.strat: Maqsad: 'explain why silica aerogel was essential to the Stardust mission'. Variant A 'because it decelerated cometary dust... without destroying' sababini to'liq beradi.

w_b8_22.exp: Choice B effectively introduces the artist (Dale Chihuly) and defines his distinctive artistic medium (large-scale blown glass fine art).
w_b8_22.strat: Maqsad: 'introduce Dale Chihuly and his artistic medium'. Variant B rassomni tanishtirib, uning asosi bo'lgan puflama shisha (blown glass) vositasini ko'rsatadi.

w_b8_23.exp: Choice D directly presents the scientific limitation: the exceptional preservation at Burgess Shale cannot be assumed to represent typical worldwide ecosystems.
w_b8_23.strat: Maqsad: 'acknowledge a limitation ... to generalize'. Variant D 'scientists caution that its diverse community may not represent typical global ecosystems' orqali cheklovni keltiradi.

w_b8_24.exp: Choice B unites both discoveries chronologically, showing how the 1963 discovery confirmed the 1912 hypothesis.
w_b8_24.strat: Maqsad: 'chronological connection between Wegener ... and Vine and Matthews'. Variant B 'Decades after 1912 ... 1963 discovery confirmed' orqali vaqt ketma-ketligini bog'laydi.

w_b8_25.exp: Choice A presents the quantitative before-and-after evidence demonstrating that planting 4,500 trees lowered summer temperatures by 2.1°C.
w_b8_25.strat: Maqsad: 'present evidence that the initiative successfully reduced heat'. Variant A 'planted 4,500 trees ... confirmed average temperature drop of 2.1°C' aniq dalilini keltiradi.

w_b8_26.exp: 'Earth, where' uses a comma and the relative adverb 'where' to smoothly attach the dependent clause describing conditions in the trenches without creating a run-on or semicolon error.
w_b8_26.strat: Grammatik chegara: Asosiy gapdan keyin izohlovchi ergash gap kelganda vergul + 'where' to'g'ri bog'laydi.

w_b8_27.exp: A colon is the correct punctuation mark following a complete independent clause when introducing an elaboration or explanation of that clause.
w_b8_27.strat: Ikki nuqta (Colon) qoidasi: To'liq gapdan keyin unga batafsil tushuntirish yoki misol berilganda ':' qo'yiladi.

w_b8_28.exp: A comma correctly sets off the nonessential appositive phrase ('an avant-garde design school...') modifying Bauhaus School.
w_b8_28.strat: Ajratilgan izoh (Appositive): 'the Bauhaus School, an avant-garde design school...' - otni izohlovchi ibora oldidan vergul tushadi.

w_b8_29.exp: The sentence already includes a comma before the blank. Joining two independent clauses requires a coordinating conjunction (FANBOYS); 'and' correctly conveys the cumulative relationship.
w_b8_29.strat: FANBOYS qoidasi: Verguldan keyin 'and' kelishi orqali ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses) to'g'ri birikadi.

w_b8_30.exp: 'That' introduces an essential (restrictive) relative clause specifying which Citizenship Schools are meant, and essential clauses are never preceded by a comma.
w_b8_30.strat: Restrictive clause (that): 'Citizenship Schools that taught...' iborasida 'that' oldidan hech qachon vergul qo'yilmaydi.

w_b8_31.exp: Joining two independent clauses with a conjunctive adverb requires a semicolon before the conjunctive adverb and a comma immediately after ('neurons; however,').
w_b8_31.strat: Semicolon + Conjunctive Adverb: Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lashda '; however,' formulasi qat'iy qo'llaniladi (vergul qo'yilsa comma splice bo'ladi).

w_b8_32.exp: A colon is used after an independent clause to introduce an explanation, appositive, or clarification of the noun phrase 'a rare electrostatic phenomenon'.
w_b8_32.strat: Izohlovchi ikki nuqta: 'a rare electrostatic phenomenon: volcanic lightning discharges...' - hodisaning aniq nomi va izohi keltirilmoqda.

w_b8_33.exp: Comma followed by the coordinating conjunction 'and' correctly joins the two independent clauses. Choice C changes the logic improperly (producing oxygen is not the reason they are abundant).
w_b8_33.strat: Bog'lovchi tanlash: Ikkita mustaqil fikrni qo'shimcha tarzda bog'lashda ', and' eng to'g'ri grammatik chegara.

w_b8_34.exp: The subject is 'weavers of the Pomo nation' and the main verb is 'harvested'. No comma should separate the subject noun phrase from its verb.
w_b8_34.strat: Ega va kesim o'rtasiga vergul qo'yilmaydi: 'weavers of the Pomo nation harvested' - orasiga noo'rin tinish belgisi kiritilmaydi.

w_b8_35.exp: Choice C uses a semicolon to separate two complete independent clauses, followed by the transitional adverb 'there' and a comma, preventing a comma splice.
w_b8_35.strat: Comma splice oldini olish: 'Florida, there she documented...' xato (comma splice). Nuqtali vergul bilan ajratilgan 'Florida; there,' to'g'ri.

w_b8_36.exp: The grammatical subject is the singular noun 'proliferation' (not the plural 'fragments' or 'systems'). A singular subject requires the singular verb 'poses'.
w_b8_36.strat: Ega-kesim moslashuvi: Ega - 'proliferation' (birlik). Oraliqdagi 'of microscopic plastic fragments' chalg'ituvchi bo'lib, kesim 'poses' birlikda bo'lishi shart.

w_b8_37.exp: This sentence uses inverted syntax: the subject follows the verb. The true subject is the plural noun phrase 'hundreds of interconnected subglacial lakes', requiring the plural verb 'lie'.
w_b8_37.strat: Inversiya (Inverted order): Gap o'rni almashgan: 'Beneath the ice lie hundreds of lakes'. Ega 'lakes' (ko'plikda), demak kesim 'lie' bo'ladi.

w_b8_38.exp: The specific past-time indicator 'In 1928' requires simple past tense ('observed').
w_b8_38.strat: Aniq o'tgan zamon belgisi: 'In 1928' ko'rsatilgani uchun fe'l faqat Simple Past ('observed') bo'lishi lozim.

w_b8_39.exp: The dependent clause uses present tense ('detect') to describe a general biological process; the main clause must maintain consistent present tense ('synthesize') to agree with plural 'they'.
w_b8_39.strat: Zamonlar muvofiqligi (General factual present): 'When cells detect..., they synthesize...' umumiy ilmiy haqiqat hozirgi zamonda bo'ladi.

w_b8_40.exp: The introductory participial phrase 'Analyzing...' must modify the logical agent performing the analysis. Sediments or discoveries cannot analyze sediments; only 'geologists' can.
w_b8_40.strat: Dangling modifier tuzog'i: 'Analyzing...' harakatini faqat geologlar bajara oladi, shuning uchun verguldan keyin 'geologists' kelishi shart.

w_b8_41.exp: The introductory modifier 'Originally constructed...' must logically describe the subject that follows the comma. Only 'the coastal stone fortress' was constructed to defend against incursions.
w_b8_41.strat: Modifier mosligi: 'Originally constructed...' faqat qal'aga ('fortress') tegishli bo'lishi mumkin, odamlar yoki kengashga emas.

w_b8_42.exp: 'The biomedical research team' is a singular collective noun acting as a single entity, requiring the singular pronoun 'it'.
w_b8_42.strat: Kollektiv ot va olmosh: 'team' birlikdagi bitta guruh sifatida qaralganda 'it' olmoshi talab etiladi.

w_b8_43.exp: 'Who' serves as the subject pronoun of the relative clause ('who had repeatedly discharged...'). 'Whom' is objective and cannot function as the subject.
w_b8_43.strat: Who vs Whom: Nisbiy gapning egasi sifatida ('who had discharged...') faqat 'who' ishlatiladi ('whom' to'ldiruvchi o'rnida keladi).

w_b8_44.exp: The sentence presents a parallel series of base-form verbs: 'molt...', 'burrow...', and 'restrict...'.
w_b8_44.strat: Parallel struktura: 'molt...', 'burrow...', and 'restrict...' - barcha fe'llar bir xil boshlang'ich zamonda bo'lishi shart.

w_b8_45.exp: Correlative conjunctions require parallel structures: 'not only to amplify... but also to dampen...'.
w_b8_45.strat: Correlative Conjunctions: 'not only [to infinitive] ... but also [to infinitive]' juftligi parallel grammatik shaklni talab qiladi.

w_b8_46.exp: The comparison is between the 'tensile strength' (singular) of sorghum and the 'tensile strength' of corn varieties. The singular demonstrative pronoun 'that of' correctly maintains logical comparison.
w_b8_46.strat: Mantiqiy taqqoslash (Logical Comparison): 'tensile strength' (birlik) bilan taqqoslashda 'that of' ishlatiladi ('those of' ko'plikka ketadi).

w_b8_47.exp: The standard English idiomatic collocation is 'consistent with'.
w_b8_47.strat: Idiomatik predlog: Ingliz tilida har doim 'consistent with' iborasi to'g'ri hisoblanadi.

w_b8_48.exp: The subject being compared is plural ('the thermal absorption characteristics'). Plural comparisons require 'those of'.
w_b8_48.strat: Ko'plikdagi taqqoslash: 'characteristics' (ko'plikda bo'lgani uchun) 'those of' bilan to'g'ri solishtiriladi.

w_b8_49.exp: Hypothetical future conditional statements using subjunctive mood require 'were' ('if emissions were to rise...').
w_b8_49.strat: Subjunctive mood (Gipotetik shart): 'if ... were to rise' gipotetik kelajak taxmini uchun 'were' to'g'ri shakldir.

w_b8_50.exp: The introductory descriptive modifier 'An elusive nocturnal inhabitant...' must logically modify the animal itself ('the spectacled bear'), not foliage or biologists or habitat.
w_b8_50.strat: Kirish iborasiga mos ega: 'An elusive nocturnal inhabitant...' ta'rifi faqat ayiqqa ('the spectacled bear') mos keladi.
